 Versus
Mohd Naseem and Others

Hon'ble Siddhartha Sah, J.
Mr. Nikhil Singhal, learned counsel for 
the revisionists.
Mr. Gaurav Pawar, learned counsel 
holding brief of Mrs. Prabha Naithani, 
learned counsel for the respondents. 
2. Learned counsel for the revisionists
would submit that the next date fixed before 
the Executing court is 13.10.2026 and if 
indulgence is not granted for an 
adjournment on that day, the very purpose 
of filing the present Civil Revision will be 
frustrated. He has placed on record a 
printout of the case status of the Civil 
Execution No.27 of 2022, which is taken on 
record.
3. On this, the learned counsel for the 
respondents submits that interim order, if 
any, may be granted only till the next date.
4. Since there is a date on 13.10.2026 before the Executing court, hence, as an 
interim measure, it is provided that in case 
an adjournment is sought on 13.10.2026
before the Executing court, the same shall 
be considered favourably only till the next 
date of listing. 
5. List on 16.10.2026.
(Siddhartha Sah, J.)
09-10-2026
JKJ/
